name: GMD / CDM Performance Review
description: Review of a city, GMD or CDM: numbers, gaps, commitments, deadlines.

sections.title: Headline
sections.instruction: One line: is this city/person on track or not, with the key number.

sections.title: Numbers Discussed
sections.instruction: Table of every metric mentioned (leads, conversion, bookings, NGMV, CGMV, collections) with target vs actual. Mark gaps as (not stated) rather than guessing.

sections.title: Gaps and Root Causes
sections.instruction: Specific gaps and the cause given for each. Separate facts stated from opinions.

sections.title: Commitments Made
sections.instruction: What each person committed to, with the number they committed to and by when.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Assigned tasks with owner and deadline, plus reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Action | Deadline | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
